plan: This is a second-price auction format where I pay the second-highest bid if I win. In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid my true value, since I win whenever my value exceeds the market price (second-highest bid) and pay only that lower amount, maximizing expected profit without risk of overpaying. Bidding below value risks losing profitable wins; bidding above value risks losses. With my value at $48, I'll bid exactly $48.

This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win). In such auctions, bidding my true value is the dominant strategy - it maximizes expected profit regardless of what others bid. Bidding higher than my value risks winning at a price exceeding my value's worth. Bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. With no prior round history to adjust for, I'll bid exactly my value of $38.
